format: 1:1 Google Meet session, English or Spanish
flow: Choose your session and pay on Stripe. Use an email address you check. If checkout offers scheduling fields, you can include two preferred times and your time zone.
Within one business day after payment, I’ll email you personally to agree on a time. I coordinate from Colombia (UTC−5). If you didn’t enter your preferences at checkout, reply with them.
Once we agree on the time, I’ll send a calendar invitation with a Google Meet link. We’ll review your material together on the call.
Within 24 hours after the session, I’ll send written notes with the decisions and next steps.

terms.en: You can reschedule at no charge up to 24 hours before the session. Reply to the scheduling email. If we can’t agree on a time within seven days after payment, you’ll receive a full refund.
terms.es: Puedes cambiar el horario sin costo hasta 24 horas antes de la sesión. Responde al correo de coordinación. Si en los siete días posteriores al pago no logramos acordar un horario, recibirás un reembolso completo.

outcome.es: El siguiente paso y una forma de comprobar si funcionó.
